summary.en: Scan for a first match, analyse failed searches, and use a sentinel only with valid writable storage.
summary.bn: একটি করে মান দেখে প্রথম মিল খুঁজে বের করো, আর sentinel-এর নিরাপদ ব্যবহার শেখো।

notes: C17 baseline; general algorithm bounds treat input size as variable.

examples.title: Find a mark in five values
examples.explanationHtml: A scan meets 7 and 3 before finding 5 at position 2.

examples.title: Use a reserved sentinel slot
examples.explanationHtml: The added 8 stops the scan at index 5. That index lies outside the five data values, so the answer is -1.

examples.title: Count all equal marks
examples.explanationHtml: The scan continues after the first 3 because the task asks for all matches. Indices 1 and 3 contribute two.

practice.title: Report a target position
practice.statementHtml: Read n (0..64), n integers (-99..99), and a target integer. Return the first matching position. Print Enter n, then n values: and Enter target: before the respective input. Finally print index = I, with -1 for absence.
hints: Use zero-based indices and handle n = 0 before accessing an element.

practice.title: Count occurrences of a roll number
practice.statementHtml: Read n (0..64), n integers (-99..99), and target. Print Enter n, then n values: and Enter target: first. Report matches = C, counting every equal value even when matches are separated.
hints: Do not return when the first equality appears.

practice.title: Explain the Linear Search invariant
practice.statementHtml: For Linear Search, state what stays true as the main process repeats. Explain the start, preservation and completed result.
hints: Use the changing boundaries and the processed region in this method.
practice.answerHtml:
Before testing position i, no position below i contains target. This is initially true because the rejected prefix is empty. If a[i] differs, advancing i extends that rejected prefix by one. If a[i] equals target, all earlier values have already failed, so i is the first matching index. If i reaches n, every value has failed and -1 is correct.

Each unsuccessful iteration increases i while n remains fixed. At most n data comparisons occur. The sentinel loop has a different stopping guarantee: the reserved cell itself equals target, so equality must occur by position n. Its final index check restores the distinction between real data and the extra stopping cell.

practice.title: Derive the resource cost of Linear Search
practice.statementHtml: Separate an immediate match, a missing target and a uniformly positioned successful target.
hints: Count the work from this algorithm rather than naming a class alone.
practice.answerHtml: Best-case search time is Θ(1) for an immediate first match on a nonempty input. Worst-case time is Θ(n) for absence or a last-position match. If a successful target position is uniformly distributed, expected comparisons are (n + 1)/2, also Θ(n). That average requires an explicit probability assumption. Both ordinary and extra-slot sentinel scans use Θ(1) working variables; the sentinel additionally needs one writable array cell.

quiz.prompt: What does linear search return for the first 3 in [7,3,5,3,1]?
quiz.explanation: Positions are zero-based and the first equality stops the scan.

quiz.prompt: Which target forces all five comparisons in [7,3,5,3,1]?
quiz.explanation: A missing value cannot be rejected until every element has been checked.

quiz.prompt: What storage does the extra-slot sentinel version require?
quiz.explanation: The stopping value must occupy a real reserved cell.

quiz.prompt: Why is a sentinel match at i = n reported as absent?
options: That cell is not one of the n data values
quiz.explanation: The final index test distinguishes the extra cell from actual data.

quiz.prompt: Which change finds the last matching position?
quiz.explanation: A later equality must be allowed to replace the earlier result.

quiz.prompt: For one query on unsorted input, why might scanning beat sorting first?
options: Binary search works on unsorted arrays
Linear search always takes one comparison
quiz.explanation: Preprocessing may cost more than the single scan it replaces.

quiz.prompt: What is the ordinary scan result for n = 0?
quiz.explanation: No array element is read when the loop condition fails immediately.

quiz.prompt: Which index does the scan find for 5 in [7,3,5,3,1]?
quiz.explanation: Indices 0 and 1 fail before index 2 matches.

quiz.prompt: Which index is returned when two entries match target 3?
quiz.explanation: The first equality returns immediately, before index 1.

quiz.prompt: What absent marker comes from a zero-length linear search?
quiz.explanation: The length check prevents every array access.

keyPoints.en: Linear search works without sorted input.
keyPoints.bn: সাজানো না থাকলেও linear search কাজ করে।

keyPoints.en: The first match can occur at index zero.
keyPoints.bn: প্রথম মিল শূন্য নম্বর অবস্থানেও হতে পারে।
না থাকলে প্রতিটি সম্ভাব্য ঘর দেখতে হয়।

keyPoints.en: Counting matches requires a complete scan.
keyPoints.bn: সব মিল গুনতে পুরো অ্যারে দেখতে হবে।

keyPoints.en: A sentinel needs a reserved writable cell.
keyPoints.bn: Sentinel বসানোর জন্য আলাদা লেখার উপযোগী ঘর লাগবে।
